verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a REST API and a Store API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or equivalent). A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate. The llms.txt file lists documentation pages and is not an API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
